title: Selected analysis scripts, bac120 phylogeny and RELAX output for a reduced freshwater clade in the Mycobacteriaceae
description:
Supporting repository for the manuscript A diverse uncultured freshwater clade with reduced genomes in the Mycobacteriaceae.

Contains the items named in the manuscript's availability statement: selected analysis scripts with the inputs they read, the bac120 species phylogeny and its alignment, and the HyPhy RELAX alignments, branch-labelled trees, command records and JSON output.

The genomes themselves are not redistributed. MAGs come from the SPIRE database and reference assemblies from NCBI, under the accessions listed in Table S1 of the manuscript's supplementary tables.
